name: Munger Ganga Bridge
facts: Shri Krishna Setu, a 3.750‑kilometre rail‑cum‑road bridge, opened to freight trains on 12 March 2016, marking a milestone in Bihar’s infrastructure under Prime Minister Narendra Modi.
The bridge, costing Rs. 9,300 million, links NH 33 on the south bank to NH 31 on the north, seamlessly connecting Munger and Jamalpur twin cities across the Ganges.
After its 2016 inauguration for rail, road traffic finally crossed Shri Krishna Setu in February 2022 once the approach roads were completed, completing the long‑awaited link.
